fieldValues.title: Does selection by relation need more than one hop?
fieldValues.thinking_reached: No option chosen. Raised as an open question in Research (2. Documents need to select records by relation), 2026-10-30, and turned into an exercise so options are explored before any decision.
fieldValues.tensions:
Options, none chosen:
- A. One hop only: records with a relation of type T to or from X. Smallest surface, matches every document measured so far.
- B. A bounded walk: n hops with a hard cap. Covers lineage and reach; needs a cap (3 hops reach all 139 muSrs problems).
- C. Path expressions over typed relations. Most expressive; closest to the unplanned query language that was removed.
fieldValues.unresolved_questions: How many real documents in more than one corpus need more than one hop. Only LiveWyer has been measured, and it needed one.
fieldValues.next_action: Write the documents the programme, the spec and muSrs actually want as selections, and count the hops each needs.
